proposed_capability: P95 and P124 with Trifecta P82/P07/P08: opportunistic, read-only lot census and cross-domain goal candidates continue while player or Sim owns active actions, while idle-only exploration uses the existing cooperative desktop admission. Extend opt-in hover ingestion to a bounded, patch-qualified, cross-session semantic affordance index without unreviewed action authority, second scheduler, duplicate house model, raw tooltip contents, autonomous persistent computer inputs or unbounded telemetry.
player_save_control_impact: Player input and player queue always own game actions; read-only observations may evaluate supplied models while player is active. No screen capture, global hooks, game input, movement, camera traverse or hover simulation from model suggestions. Any later idle exploration requires independent current scene/patch/lot/actor and double-probe host screen admission by workflow_interop and canonical camera restoration; no protected save mutation, no EA Connect, no automatic service installation.
expected_outcome: An ACTIVE host listener emits bounded, revision-scoped needs/career opportunity maps from attested rooms on every tick even while the player is active. Queue saturation defers enqueue but does not prevent passive evaluation. Unknown mappings are prioritized for safe future exploration, not fake opportunities. Approved event-based hover observations persist tokenized target/tooltip/action/outcome associations across session IDs with deduplication, size bounds and game build scoping, allowing rediscovery avoidance. An explicit asynchronous runner can poll supplied observations while user plays; it can queue validated idle-only exploration through the existing cooperative screen gate but never claims automatic SendInput or game certification.
